outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo (sequence-type panel), not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Scatter/mean±SEM plot of inhibition zone percentages clearly shows individual gray dots for each biological replicate, alongside disk diffusion photographs.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data.
Mean±SEM fluorescence intensity plot shows individual yellow circles representing individual cells.
Mean±SEM fluorescence intensity plot (log scale) shows individual blue circles representing individual cells.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM point-cloud images (micrograph-type single-molecule localization data), not a summary plot of averaged data.
Mean±SEM plot of clusters/cell displays individual gray dots for each cell.
Mean±SEM plot of cluster sizes (log scale) displays individual gray dots for each cluster.
Mean±SEM plot of molecule percentage in clusters displays individual gray dots for each cell.
